title: Regression testing for AI-written changes
summary: Counter the blind spot where the same model writes and reviews a change: lock fixed bugs behind deterministic tests, and check every parallel code path a fix could miss.

provenance.notes: ECC's central observation, that self-review repeats the author's assumptions, is why this repository requires runtime verification and an independent reviewer; this skill is the test-design half.

inputs.name: defect
inputs.description: The bug that was found and fixed, with a minimal reproduction.

inputs.name: paths
inputs.description: Every code path that should behave the same (production, fallback, feature flag, mock mode).

outputs.name: regression-tests
outputs.description: Deterministic tests that fail on the original defect.

outputs.name: path-matrix
outputs.description: Which parallel paths were checked and which were not.

workflow.step: Reproduce the defect with the smallest deterministic input and write the test that fails on it before touching the fix.
workflow.check: The test fails on the unfixed code.

workflow.step: List every path that handles the same data: main path, fallback, cache, mock or sandbox mode, retry path.
workflow.check: The list comes from searching the code, not from memory.

workflow.step: Add or confirm a test for each path; a fix applied to one path and not the others is the most common regression.
workflow.check: Each path has its own assertion.

workflow.step: Do not accept the author's own review as evidence; require the test result and an independent reviewer.
workflow.check: Evidence is a test outcome, not a statement.

workflow.step: Keep the regression test next to the code it protects and name it after the defect.

constraints: Tests must be deterministic: no network, no wall-clock dependence, fixed seeds.
Never mark a bug fixed on the basis of the model saying it is fixed.
Do not skip a parallel path because it is hard to reach; report it as untested.

examples.title: Field added to one response path
examples.situation: A field was added to the live response but not the fallback response.
examples.guidance: Write a test per path asserting the field; the fallback assertion would have failed first.

verification: The regression test fails on the original defect and passes on the fix.
Every identified parallel path has a test or is listed as untested.

task.text: Add a regression test so the fixed bug cannot reintroduce; check the fallback parallel path too.
The same model did the self-review of this bug fix; look for a blind spot in the sandbox path.
Design for regression of the fixed bug.
